title: Refill Size Percentage for Home Oxygen Therapy Contents Months
content:
# Refill Size Percentage — Home Oxygen Therapy Contents Months

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy contents month paid in full by the coverage, the contents amount is multiplied by **110 percent** when at least one cylinder refill is on record and the cylinder refills on record average **10** or more cylinders per refill, by **90 percent** when at least one cylinder refill is on record and they average **5** or fewer, and by **100 percent** otherwise, including when no cylinder refill is on record. The average is the cylinders delivered on the cylinder refills in the patient's oxygen service history divided by the number of those refills. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Both sides of each figure (hypothetical refill histories)

| Cylinder refills on record | Cylinders delivered on them | Average per refill | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 40 | 10 | 110 |
| 4 | 38 | 9.5 | 100 |
| 4 | 22 | 5.5 | 100 |
| 4 | 20 | 5 | 90 |
| 0 | — | no average | 100 |

## Points of judgement

**Is the boundary figure itself included?** Yes, on both sides: an average of exactly 10 is "10 or more", and an average of exactly 5 is "5 or fewer".

**What applies when the service history shows no cylinder refill?** 100 percent.

**Worked figure.** A hypothetical contents amount of 90.00 with an average of 12 cylinders per refill becomes 90.00 multiplied by 110 percent, 99.00.
